title: Quant Lab
subtitle: Historical simulation and portfolio analytics. Everything here describes the past — none of it is a prediction or financial advice.

backtest.title: Strategy backtest
backtest.hint: Signals are traded on the following bar and costs are charged on every position change, so the result is net.
backtest.walkForwardNote: Parameters were chosen on earlier bars only and applied unchanged to the next block. The Deflated Sharpe corrects for {{trials}} parameter set(s) tested.
backtest.overfitWarning: The Deflated Sharpe does not clear the multiple-testing bar — this result is consistent with having picked the luckiest of several rules.
backtest.survives: The Deflated Sharpe stays positive after correcting for the parameter search.

optimize.title: Portfolio optimization
optimize.hint: Optimal weights over your real holdings. Mean-variance optimises the past; historical mean returns are a weak forecast of future ones.
optimize.notConverged: The constrained solver did not converge — showing the minimum-variance portfolio instead of the true tangency portfolio.

risk.title: Portfolio risk
risk.hint: Losses are shown as positive percentages. Historical VaR cannot see a loss larger than the worst day in the window.

disclaimer: Historical simulation on instruments that exist today, which is itself a survivorship bias. Past performance does not predict future results. Not financial advice.
